title: Refactor Mass Spec framework to Project hierarchy

decision_summary.app_project_selection: user explicitly opens ProjectMassSpecSpectra for spectra work, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms for chromatogram work, or ProjectNonTargetAnalysis for NTS work, mirroring scripting constructors
decision_summary.domain_rule: Each project row has its own domain-specific project_id and immutable domain; supported Mass Spec-derived domains are mass_spec_spectra, mass_spec_chromatograms, and mass_spec_nts.
decision_summary.documentation_rule: Whenever code is added or changed, revise and add missing documentation in both R roxygen headers and C++ source/comments where absent.
decision_summary.phase_reporting_rule: Each implementation phase must produce a Markdown report under .ai_plan recording completed work, verification status, remaining gaps, and recommended next steps.
decision_summary.rcpp_devtools_rule: After any Rcpp/export-affecting change, regenerate exports as needed, then run devtools::load_all(); fix any compilation or linking errors reported there before considering the phase complete. Compile validation should use devtools::load_all() as the active compile path.

objectives: Replace Engine-centric orchestration with a Project class hierarchy.

Refactor the Mass Spec hierarchy so ProjectMassSpec becomes the shared/internal Mass Spec base while ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, and ProjectNonTargetAnalysis provide the public domain-specific project interfaces.
Move shared Mass Spec parsing, metadata, raw/header storage, and common helpers into ProjectMassSpec backed by the shared project DuckDB.
Move spectra-specific processed storage and processing into ProjectMassSpecSpectra backed by the shared project DuckDB.
Move chromatogram-specific processed storage and processing into ProjectMassSpecChromatograms backed by the shared project DuckDB.
Move non-target screening schema and processing into ProjectNonTargetAnalysis backed by the same shared project DuckDB.
Replace global processing-method discovery with project-owned processing registries exposed by ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, and ProjectNonTargetAnalysis.
Refactor Workflow to validate ordered processing methods against the active Project child class registry and dependency network.

Move the public/query/result methods currently implemented on R/class_MassSpecResults_NonTargetAnalysis.R onto ProjectNonTargetAnalysis following the same project-owned pattern used for the Mass Spec child classes.
Remove dependence on separate MassSpecResults_*.duckdb files.
Adapt the app and workflow system to operate on explicit ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, or ProjectNonTargetAnalysis objects instead of Engines.

Absorb standalone DB-wrapper responsibilities currently implemented by R/class_Results.R, R/class_AuditTrail.R, R/class_Cache.R, and R/class_Analyses.R into Project-derived classes or shared project helpers.

Retire legacy R classes in stages after their behavior is migrated: R/class_MassSpecResults_NonTargetAnalysis.R, R/class_MassSpecResults_Chromatograms.R, R/class_MassSpecResults_Spectra.R, R/class_MassSpecEngine.R, and finally R/class_MassSpecAnalyses.R.
Systematically clean up legacy code, compatibility layers, dead exports, and obsolete app/workflow paths as the new project-based architecture replaces them.
Ensure implementation work always updates or adds missing documentation in both R roxygen and C++.
Produce a Markdown implementation report for every phase under .ai_plan to record verification results and remaining work.

rules: After changes to Rcpp exports, [[Rcpp::export]] functions, native signatures, or generated bindings, regenerate the Rcpp exports before verification.
Use devtools::load_all() as the required development-framework validation pass after export-affecting or compile-affecting changes.
Compilation or linking errors reported in devtools::load_all() output must be fixed in the same implementation phase, not deferred silently.
If devtools::load_all() output shows export/signature mismatches, regenerate Rcpp exports and rerun validation in the same phase.
Avoid concurrent regeneration/compile runs during validation because they can interfere with incremental Windows builds.
Phase reports must state whether Rcpp exports were regenerated and whether devtools::load_all() passed.

scope: C++ source and header comments where documentation is absent or outdated
rules: When public R functions, R6 methods, S3 methods, or user-facing behavior changes, update roxygen documentation in the same phase.
When new C++ facades, exported functions, schema owners, or non-obvious processing paths are introduced, add or revise succinct C++ documentation if missing.
Generated files should be regenerated after documentation-affecting changes rather than manually edited.

classes.name: Project
classes.role: Shared root object for db, project_id, immutable domain, metadata, workflow, audit, and generic project services. Each project row is domain-specific.

classes.name: ProjectMassSpec
classes.role: Shared/internal Mass Spec base for import, raw/header storage, shared Mass Spec querying, and common Mass Spec helpers used by Mass Spec child project classes.

classes.name: ProjectMassSpecSpectra
classes.role: Public spectra-specific project facade for MS_SPECTRA persistence, spectra processing, spectra querying, and the spectra processing-method registry exposed through available_processing_methods().

classes.name: ProjectMassSpecChromatograms
classes.role: Public chromatogram-specific project facade for MS_CHROMATOGRAMS persistence, chromatogram processing, chromatogram querying, and the chromatogram processing-method registry exposed through available_processing_methods().

classes.name: ProjectNonTargetAnalysis
classes.role: Public NTS project facade for feature finding, grouping, suspect screening, transformation products, other src/nts-backed processing, and the NTS processing-method registry exposed through available_processing_methods().

cpp_facades.name: project::PROJECT
cpp_facades.responsibility: Shared project context and root schema.

cpp_facades.name: mass_spec::PROJECT_MASS_SPEC
cpp_facades.responsibility: Shared/internal Mass Spec schema owner and common Mass Spec helper facade.

cpp_facades.name: mass_spec::PROJECT_MASS_SPEC_SPECTRA
cpp_facades.responsibility: Spectra-specific processed schema and spectra processing facade.

cpp_facades.name: mass_spec::PROJECT_MASS_SPEC_CHROMATOGRAMS
cpp_facades.responsibility: Chromatogram-specific processed schema and chromatogram processing facade.

cpp_facades.name: nts::PROJECT_NON_TARGET_ANALYSIS
cpp_facades.responsibility: NTS schema and NTS processing facade.

notes: All Mass Spec and NTS tables live in the main project DuckDB.
Each project row in the Project table is specific to one domain and has its own project_id.
All domain tables include project_id and are scoped to the owning domain-specific project row.
No separate result database files are created for Mass Spec or NTS outputs.

legacy_removal_order: Stop creating or relying on standalone wrappers R/class_Results.R, R/class_AuditTrail.R, R/class_Cache.R, and R/class_Analyses.R as Project-derived classes absorb those responsibilities.
Move methods from R/class_MassSpecResults_NonTargetAnalysis.R to ProjectNonTargetAnalysis first.
Remove R/class_MassSpecResults_NonTargetAnalysis.R once ProjectNonTargetAnalysis owns the migrated behavior.
Remove R/class_MassSpecResults_Chromatograms.R after ProjectMassSpecChromatograms owns its remaining behavior.
Remove R/class_MassSpecResults_Spectra.R after ProjectMassSpecSpectra owns its remaining behavior.
Remove R/class_MassSpecEngine.R after workflow/app/runtime no longer depend on Engine-based Mass Spec orchestration.
Remove R/class_MassSpecAnalyses.R last after all remaining callers use ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, or ProjectNonTargetAnalysis directly.
Remove any residual standalone wrappers R/class_Results.R, R/class_AuditTrail.R, R/class_Cache.R, and R/class_Analyses.R once no active path constructs them.

legacy_to_target_mapping.migration_note: Move public/query/result methods and shared-db persistence here using the project-owned method-placement pattern used for the domain-specific Mass Spec child classes.
Move chromatogram result access/query/plot methods here once shared-db chromatogram tables are complete.
Move spectra result access/query/plot methods here once shared-db spectra tables are complete.
Retire engine-owned runtime orchestration once workflow/app paths use project-owned methods directly.
Keep only as temporary compatibility wrapper until callers use the domain-specific Mass Spec project classes directly.
Replace standalone result-db wrappers with project child query methods over the shared project DB.
Expose audit access through Project methods and shared project helpers rather than a standalone S3 wrapper.

legacy_to_target_mapping.target_owner: R/class_Project.R or retained internal helper module
legacy_to_target_mapping.migration_note: Remove public standalone cache wrapper once active callers no longer construct it directly.
Drop the generic analyses DB wrapper once shared Mass Spec base/project-owned analysis APIs fully replace it.
Replace root engine lifecycle, metadata, workflow, and audit access with the Project root object.

project_mass_spec_tables.shared_base_role: Shared raw/header storage owned by the internal/shared ProjectMassSpec layer.

schema_rules: The Project table stores an immutable domain per project_id, so workflow and domain data are specific to that domain-specific project row.
NTS tables also include analysis and stable feature/component identifiers.
New tables should be created and validated from the owning C++ project facade.

processing_model.recommended_runtime_api: project$run_processing_step(step) with project$run_workflow() for ordered execution
required_processing_step_changes: Add owner_class field to ProcessingStep metadata.

Implement available_processing_methods() on ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, and ProjectNonTargetAnalysis to return the registered method names, owner class, dependency network, and supporting metadata for that project facade.
Replace run.<step>(x, engine = NULL) with run.<step>(x, project = NULL) or equivalent project-owned dispatch.
Make Workflow validation aware of the active project object/class registry rather than global type-based method discovery.
Update processing method discovery to resolve from project$available_processing_methods() instead of engine type strings or namespace-wide scans.
Keep owner_class metadata as a descriptive field, but treat the project registry as the authoritative source of availability and dependencies.
Use ProcessingStep$method as the single canonical runtime dispatch key and make it match the owning project child method name.
Keep shared Mass Spec algorithms in common src/mass_spec utilities while registering them separately in spectra and chromatogram project registries where applicable.

project_registry_examples.notes: Registry covers spectra-specific processed storage and spectra processing.
Registry covers chromatogram-specific processed storage and chromatogram processing.
Registry covers NTS-specific feature/component/suspect processing and uses the shared/internal Mass Spec layer for common MS access.

app_refactor.goal: Make the app operate on explicit ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, and ProjectNonTargetAnalysis objects, constructed the same way users would create them in scripting, instead of Engines.
required_changes: Replace engine bootstrap in R/app_server.R with explicit ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, or ProjectNonTargetAnalysis construction and selection.

Make app project selection mirror scripting entrypoints so spectra users open ProjectMassSpecSpectra, chromatogram users open ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, and NTS users open ProjectNonTargetAnalysis.
Replace engine reactives with project reactives for metadata, workflow, audit, and domain-specific accessors.
Refactor R/app_mod_Workflow.R to discover methods and dependencies from project$available_processing_methods().
Replace result loading helpers that scan Results*.duckdb with queries against the main project DB.
Update explorer and reporting modules to use project child methods directly.

inventory_requirements: Map each legacy class to its new owner class.
Map each standalone DB wrapper class to either a Project method, a Project child method, or a retained generic helper if it is still needed.
Map each legacy table to a shared-project-db replacement table.
Map each run.<step> implementation to ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, or ProjectNonTargetAnalysis.
Map each app module dependency on engine fields to project methods.
Map each legacy file in dev/legacy_code to delete, retain as reference temporarily, or migrate.
acceptance_criteria: Mass Spec workflows do not require Engine or MassSpecEngine.
Mass Spec and NTS processing write only to the shared project DB.
ProjectMassSpec is the shared/internal Mass Spec base for parsing, common storage, and shared helpers.
ProjectMassSpecSpectra is the sole public owner of spectra-specific processed storage and processing.
ProjectMassSpecChromatograms is the sole public owner of chromatogram-specific processed storage and processing.
ProjectNonTargetAnalysis is the sole owner of NTS schema and processing.
ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, and ProjectNonTargetAnalysis each expose available_processing_methods() as the authoritative processing registry for that project class.
ProcessingStep$method matches the owning project child method name and is the single runtime dispatch key across project registries and workflows.
The app runs against Project-derived classes and no longer depends on Results*.duckdb files.
The app allows the user to open ProjectMassSpecSpectra, ProjectMassSpecChromatograms, or ProjectNonTargetAnalysis explicitly, matching scripting usage.
Active package paths no longer construct standalone Results, AuditTrail, Cache, or Analyses wrappers when equivalent Project-derived behavior exists.
Workflow storage is specific to the domain-specific project row identified by project_id and domain.
Workflow step availability and dependency validation are restricted by the active project registry.
No active app, workflow, or package path depends on legacy Engine/result-db code or dev/legacy_code artifacts.
risks: App coupling to engine state is broader than the initial surface suggests.
Many run methods currently assume legacy result objects and separate database files.
ProcessingStep discovery is currently dataType-string-based and will need a controlled replacement.
DESCRIPTION Collate and generated documentation will require coordinated updates during migration.
Some NTS code paths may assume a separate database boundary and need explicit table API redesign.
Legacy code cleanup can accidentally remove still-collated or still-generated symbols if inventory and removal sequencing are not enforced.
open_questions: Should available_processing_methods() return only runnable methods, or also include informative legacy/disabled methods flagged as unavailable?
Should workflow serialization store only ordered steps, or also persist a snapshot of the registry/dependency metadata used during validation?
Do we want temporary compatibility wrappers during migration, or a hard cutover once project-based paths are ready?
next_recommended_action: Implement spectra and chromatogram processing registries using the same method-name-only workflow contract already established for ProjectNonTargetAnalysis, then continue app and legacy-wrapper cleanup around that unified registry surface.
